design_principle: neutral scientific canvas with semantic accents

semantic_roles.topology: physical structure and neutral baseline geometry
semantic_roles.viable: sustainable, admissible, operational or recovery state
semantic_roles.critical: constraint, disturbance, critical boundary or propagation
semantic_roles.causal: causal interface, highlighted mechanism or engineering intervention

color_redundancy.critical: red + dashed critical overlay + explicit label
color_redundancy.causal: light-yellow fill + dark-ochre stroke + double/dashed interface line + interface label

scientific_boundary: Color and visual emphasis encode model semantics only; they do not strengthen the evidence class of a scientific claim.
